title: Farm life and the city house
summary: They lived on the farm until he was about 12, and the family had all it needed.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: When you were growing up then, you were on this farm?
Well, yes, up until about 12. Then she also had a city house which was just about three miles from the farm.
So the farms kind of supported your mother.

Yeah. Well, see, my father was a farmer that -- well, we raised everything like we had -- she had a beautiful garden and we just had about everything we needed, like meats and calves, you know, we had cows and we had everything we really needed. So I didn't have a hard time, you know, in that respect, you know.
